EXT.evidence: Very talkative and demonstrative: makes loud playful statements (“smack my ass,” “call me ‘Judy,’” “Hey! Sugar‑O’s!”), keeps initiating chatter and doing voices for Gummi-bears; not reserved.

AGR.evidence: Uncooperative and inconsiderate: refuses repeated polite requests to hand over the Gummi-bears (“No,” “you can’t have any”), won’t wait for the planned course, disrupts the host’s dinner.

CON.evidence: Impulsive and disorganized: can’t wait a few minutes for onion tartlets, rummages without purpose (“I don’t know what I’m looking for”), insists on making macaroni and cheese against the plan, plays with food during dinner.

NEU.evidence: Shows confidence and lack of anxiety: playful, bold comments and jokes, carefree behavior, no signs of nervousness or sensitivity (e.g., says could eat a hundred ravioli, acts silly and relaxed).

OPN.evidence: Highly imaginative and playful: creative metaphor (“taco shells are like little corn envelopes”) and personification/story about a drowning Gummi-bear; open to novel foods and experiences.
